title: Ramsey number R(3,17), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_3 and no blue K_17; it shows R(3,17) > n. The best known lower bound is R(3,17) >= 93, so a colouring of K_92 is known and one of K_93 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(3,17) >= 93: NaRT repository, 22 Oct 2026; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 92; read 5 Nov 2026
